routing_rules.rule_1_hard_failsafe: risk >= 0.90 or (tool in HIGH_RISK_TOOLS and risk >= HIGH_RISK_THRESHOLD)
routing_rules.rule_2_repeated_failures: attempt_count > 2 -> ESCALATE_T2 (or FAIL_SAFE if T2 offline)
routing_rules.rule_3_read_only_tools: tool in READ_ONLY_TOOLS and verification != 'FAILED' -> ACCEPT_T1
routing_rules.rule_5_direct_acceptance: confidence >= T2_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD and risk < HIGH_RISK_THRESHOLD and verification == 'PASSED' -> ACCEPT_T1
routing_rules.rule_6_elevated_risk_low_conf: confidence < T2_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD or risk >= HIGH_RISK_THRESHOLD -> ESCALATE_T2
